alts.name: Proton Mail

alts.name: Tuta Mail

alts.imp: Currently supports manual migration. Use desktop client for bulk import.

alts.name: Fastmail
alts.desc: Australian privacy-focused email. Excellent UI, great import tools, custom domains.
alts.imp: Settings → Migration → Add Gmail account for automatic import

alts.name: Mailbox.org
alts.desc: German privacy email with office suite, calendar, cloud storage. GDPR-first.
alts.imp: Use IMAP migration wizard in admin panel

alts.name: Proton Drive
alts.desc: E2E encrypted cloud storage from Proton. Integrates with Proton ecosystem.
alts.imp: Upload files directly through web or desktop client

alts.name: Nextcloud
alts.desc: Self-hosted cloud platform. Full Google Workspace replacement. Maximum control.
alts.imp: Upload via desktop sync client or web interface. Supports WebDAV.

alts.name: Tresorit
alts.desc: Swiss E2E encrypted cloud storage. Business-grade with zero-knowledge encryption.

alts.name: Filen
alts.desc: German zero-knowledge encrypted cloud. Fast uploads, generous free tier.
alts.imp: Upload via web or desktop client from Takeout export folder

alts.name: DuckDuckGo
alts.desc: Most popular private search engine. No tracking, no search history stored.
alts.imp: Set as default search engine in your browser settings

alts.name: Brave Search
alts.desc: Independent index (not reliant on Google/Bing). Built by Brave Software.

alts.name: Startpage
alts.desc: Anonymized Google results without the tracking. Best of both worlds.
alts.imp: Set as default search engine or use browser extension

alts.name: Kagi

alts.imp: Create account and set as default search engine

alts.desc: Open-source browser by Mozilla. Huge extension library. Community #1 for privacy.

alts.name: Brave
alts.desc: Chromium-based with built-in ad/tracker blocking, VPN, and privacy features.
alts.imp: Import Chrome data during setup. Extensions are compatible.

alts.name: LibreWolf
alts.desc: Hardened Firefox fork. Maximum privacy out of the box. No telemetry.

alts.name: Vivaldi
alts.desc: Feature-rich Chromium browser. Built-in mail, calendar, notes. No tracking.
alts.imp: Import Chrome data during setup. Chromium extension compatible.

alts.desc: E2E encrypted calendar. Seamlessly integrates with Proton Mail.

alts.name: Tuta Calendar
alts.desc: Encrypted calendar built into Tuta. Zero-knowledge encryption.
alts.imp: Import .ics calendar file through calendar settings

alts.name: EteSync
alts.desc: Secure E2E encrypted calendar/contacts sync. Works with standard CalDAV apps.

alts.name: Immich

alts.name: Ente Photos

alts.name: PhotoPrism

alts.imp: Copy photos to import directory, then run indexer via web UI

alts.name: OsmAnd
alts.desc: Offline maps based on OpenStreetMap. No tracking, fully offline capable.

alts.name: Organic Maps
alts.desc: Privacy-focused offline maps. Fork of Maps.me without tracking. Very fast.

alts.name: Magic Earth
alts.desc: Free navigation with real-time traffic. No tracking, no ads.
alts.imp: Install app. Supports offline maps and turn-by-turn navigation.

alts.name: FreeTube
alts.desc: Desktop YouTube client. No tracking, no ads. Import subscriptions.

alts.name: Invidious
alts.desc: Alternative YouTube frontend. No JavaScript required, no tracking.
alts.imp: Import subscriptions via OPML file from YouTube Takeout data

alts.name: Odysee / LBRY

alts.name: Rumble
alts.desc: Free speech video platform. Growing creator ecosystem with monetization options.
alts.imp: Create account and manually re-upload or subscribe to migrated creators

alts.name: Kick
alts.desc: Live streaming and video platform. Creator-friendly revenue split. Growing community.
alts.imp: Create account and follow your preferred creators on the platform

alts.name: LibreOffice
alts.desc: Full open-source office suite. Excellent MS Office compatibility.

alts.name: CryptPad
alts.desc: Zero-knowledge encrypted collaborative suite. Docs, sheets, presentations.

alts.name: ONLYOFFICE
alts.desc: Full office suite compatible with MS formats. Self-hostable. Real-time collab.

alts.name: Element (Matrix)

alts.name: Standard Notes

alts.name: Joplin

alts.name: Obsidian
alts.desc: Powerful knowledge base. Local-first Markdown files. Plugin ecosystem.

alts.name: Aegis
alts.desc: Open-source 2FA app. Encrypted vault, biometric unlock, backup/restore.

alts.name: Ente Auth
alts.desc: E2E encrypted 2FA with cloud backup. Cross-platform. Open source.
alts.imp: Scan QR codes or import from Google Authenticator export

alts.name: KeePassXC
alts.desc: Offline-first open-source password manager. Local encrypted database.

alts.desc: E2E encrypted password manager from Proton. Integrates with Proton ecosystem.

alts.name: DeepL
alts.desc: Superior translation quality. European privacy standards.

alts.name: LibreTranslate
alts.desc: Open-source machine translation. Self-hostable. No tracking.
alts.imp: Use web interface or self-host your own instance

alts.name: Aurora Store
alts.desc: Access Play Store apps without a Google account. Anonymous downloads.

alts.name: LineageOS
alts.desc: Open-source Android ROM. Wide device support. No Google services by default.

alts.name: CalyxOS
alts.desc: Privacy-focused Android with microG. Good balance of privacy and usability.
